y-m-36-02.title: Sanin tushe ɗaya yana ƙayyade ƙididdigogi?
y-m-36-02.topic: Tushe ɗaya na ma’aunin murabba’i da bayanin da ake buƙata don ƙayyade ƙididdigogi
y-m-36-02.goal: Yi lissafin yawan ƙididdigogin da bayanin “an bayar da tushe ɗaya” yake ƙayyadewa, zaɓi ƙarin bayanin da ya isa ƙayyade ƙididdigogi da amsa guda ɗaya, sannan ƙirƙiri misali da kanka da ya cika sharuddan.
y-m-36-02.material: Ga ma’aunin murabba’i x² + ax + b = 0 (a da b lambobi ne na gaske), abin da ka sani kawai shi ne x = 2 tushe ne. Soyeong ta ce, “Idan ka saka x = 2, za ka iya nemo a da b,” Daon kuma ya ce, “Wannan kaɗai bai isa ba.” (Karanta: x murabba’i da a x da b daidai yake da 0)
y-m-36-02.thinking.0: Kwatanta yawan bayanai (yawan ma’aunai) da yawan abubuwan da ba a sani ba don gano
y-m-36-02.thinking.1: Gwada ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko ƙarin bayanin ya isa
y-m-36-02.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri misali da ya cika dukkan sharuddan
y-m-36-02.prereq.0: Ma’anar tushen ma’auni (saka tushen yana sa ma’aunin ya zama gaskiya)
y-m-36-02.prereq.1: Dangantakar tushen biyu na ma’aunin murabba’i da ƙididdigoginsa (matakin sashen ma’aunai na aji 10) — H2 na wannan aiki matakin wahala da tallafi ne kawai a rabon samarwa; ba yana nufin manhaja ta ware wannan batu ga wannan aji ba. A ɗauka an riga an koyi ilimin da ake buƙata a ƙasa.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.prompt: Kwatanta abin da Soyeong da Daon suka ce, sannan zaɓi hukuncin da ya fi dacewa game da bayanin da aka sani yanzu.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.hint.0: Saka a = 0, 1, −1 ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan daidaita b ta yadda x = 2 zai zama tushe.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bincika ko duk nau’i-nau’in da ka ƙirƙira sun cika sharuddan. Idan haka ne, amsoshi nawa ne?
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.a: Ma’auni guda ɗaya da aka samu ta saka x = 2 yana ba ka damar nemo a da b duka.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.a: Wannan yana ɗaukar cewa ma’auni guda ɗaya zai iya ƙayyade abubuwa biyu da ba a sani ba. Gwada nemo b idan a = 0, 1, da −1.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.b: Idan x = 2 tushe ne, to b dole ya zama 0.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.b: Ba ka bincika ko akwai dalilin b ya zama 0 idan tushen ba 0 ba ne. Nemo b idan a = 0.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.c: Domin an bayar da tushe ɗaya kawai, dole ma’aunin ya kasance da tushe biyu iri ɗaya.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya ɗauki “tushe ɗaya da aka sani” da “tushe guda ɗaya kawai” a matsayin abu ɗaya. Nemo duk tushen idan a = −1.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.d: Sakawa yana ba da ma’auni guda ɗaya kawai, saboda haka ba za a iya ƙayyade a da b da amsa guda ɗaya ba.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci yana kwatanta yawan abubuwan da ba a sani ba da yawan ma’aunai da aka samu.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.explain: Saka x = 2 yana ba da ma’auni guda ɗaya, 4 + 2a + b = 0. Abubuwan da ba a sani ba biyu ne, a da b, saboda haka akwai nau’i-nau’i marasa iyaka, kamar (a, b) = (0, −4), (−1, −2), (1, −6). Bayar da tushe ɗaya ba yana nufin sauran tushen yana da ƙima ɗaya da shi ba.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.prompt: A ce an bayar da kowane ƙarin bayani dabam. Zaɓi duk ƙarin bayanin da ya isa ƙayyade a da b da amsa guda ɗaya.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, rubuta sabon bayanin a matsayin ma’auni, ka warware shi tare da ma’aunin da kake da shi, 4 + 2a + b = 0, sannan ka ƙirga yawan nau’i-nau’in (a, b) da aka samu.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ga zaɓuɓɓukan da ba su ƙayyade amsa ba, bincika ta hanyar ƙirƙirar nau’i-nau’i biyu daban-daban da suka cika sharadin.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.a: Ka bincika ko sanin tushen biyun yana ƙayyade a da b ta hanyar jimilla da ninkin.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.b: Wannan hukunci yana bincika ko za ka iya gano b ta haɗa shi da ma’aunin da kake da shi, 4 + 2a + b = 0.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.o.c: a da b duka lambobi cikakku ne.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.c: Ba ka ƙirga nau’i-nau’in da suka cika 4 + 2a + b = 0 bayan sharadin lambobi cikakku ba. (0, −4) da (−2, 0) duka nau’i-nau’i ne na lambobi cikakku.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.o.d: Tushen biyu lambobi ne na ainihi dabam-dabam.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.d: Ba ka bambanta bayanin da ke rage zaɓuɓɓuka da wanda ke tantance amsa guda ba. Akwai nau’i-nau’i da yawa (a, b) da suka cika wannan sharadi.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.e: Wannan hukunci yana bincika ko sabuwar dangantaka tare da ma’aunin farko suna samar da ma’auni biyu.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.explain: Idan ɗayan tushen −3 ne, jimillar −1 = −a ce, ninkar kuma −6 = b ce, don haka waɗannan sun tantance su. Idan a = −1, to b = −2. Idan b = a + 2, to 4 + 2a + a + 2 = 0 yana ba da a = −2, b = 0. Sharadin lambobi cikakku da na tushen ainihi dabam suna rage zaɓuɓɓuka kawai; nau’i-nau’i da dama sun rage.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon ƙirƙiri nau’i-nau’i biyu dabam (a, b) inda a da b lambobi cikakku ne, tushen ma’aunin x² + ax + b = 0 kuma lambobi ne tabbatattu na ainihi dabam-dabam, ɗayansu 2.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko yi amfani da 4 + 2a + b = 0 don bayyana b ta amfani da a, sannan ka rubuta ɗayan tushen ta amfani da a.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.hint.1: Gwada ƙimomin a da dama domin ɗayan tushen ya zama tabbatacce amma ba 2 ba.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Da fatan lambobin a da b duka su zama lambobi cikakku.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Idan aka saka x = 2, furucin bai zama 0 ba.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.ok.c3: Ɗayan tushen lamba ce tabbatacciya wadda ba 2 ba.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c3: Ɗayan tushen ba tabbatacce ba ne ko kuma 2 ne, don haka ba ya samar da tushen tabbatattu biyu dabam-dabam.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.explain: Misali, (a, b) = (−3, 2) yana ba da x² − 3x + 2 = (x − 1)(x − 2), tushen 1 da 2; (−5, 6) kuma yana ba da tushen 2 da 3. (−4, 4) yana da tushe guda 2 (tushe mai maimaituwa), (−1, −2) kuma ɗayan tushen −1 ne, don haka ba su cika sharuɗɗan ba. Nau’i-nau’i da yawa sun cika dukkan sharuɗɗan, don haka kuma ka tabbatar sharuddan ba su tantance amsa guda ba.

y-m-36-09.title: Ma’aunin digiri biyu da jimilla da ninkar tushensa duka tabbatattu ne
y-m-36-09.topic: Alamomin tushen ma’aunin digiri biyu da sharuɗɗan jimilla da ninkar tushen
y-m-36-09.goal: Nemo sharadin da ya ɓace a da’awar cewa idan jimilla da ninkar duka tabbatattu ne, tushen biyu tabbatattu ne, ta ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa, sannan ka gyara da’awar.
y-m-36-09.material: Mina ta yi da’awa: Ga ma’aunin x² − sx + q = 0 (s da q lambobi ne na ainihi), idan jimilla s da ninkar q na tushen biyu duka tabbatattu ne, to tushen biyu lambobi ne tabbatattu na ainihi. (Karatu: x murabba’i a rage sx a ƙara q daidai da 0.) Jimillar tushen biyu s ce, ninkarsu kuma q ce.
y-m-36-09.thinking.0: Yi hukunci ko da’awar kullum take aiki.
y-m-36-09.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa mai cika sharadi amma ƙarshe bai tabbata ba.
y-m-36-09.thinking.2: Gyara da’awar ta ƙara sharadin da zai sa ta yi aiki.
y-m-36-09.prereq.0: Dangantakar da ke bayyana jimilla da ninkar tushen ma’aunin digiri biyu ta amfani da ƙididdigoginsa
y-m-36-09.prereq.1: Yadda ake tantance ko tushen ma’aunin digiri biyu lambobi ne na ainihi (matakin sashen ma’auni na aji 10) — H2 yana nufin matakin wahala da tallafi kawai, ba warewar darasi ga aji ba. A ɗauka an riga an koyi ilimin da ake buƙata.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukuncinka na farko game da da’awar Minar.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.hint.0: Saka wasu nau’i-nau’i na lambobi tabbatattu na musamman a matsayin s da q, ka nemo tushen ma’aunin da kanka.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko akwai yanayin da tushen ba lambobi na ainihi ba ne, sannan ka tantance ko ƙarshe cewa lambobi ne tabbatattu na ainihi har yanzu daidai ne.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.a: Yana aiki ne kawai idan jimilla tabbatacciya ce kuma ninkar ba ta da kyau.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.a: Ka karanta dangantakar akasin hanya: ninkar tabbatacciya tana nufin tushen biyu alamarsu ɗaya ce.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.b: Akwai yanayin da bai aiki ba. Ɗaya daga cikin tushen na iya zama korau.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.b: Ba ka lura cewa idan ninkar tabbatacciya ce, tushen ainihi biyu suna da alama ɗaya ba. Ƙirƙiri wasu nau’i-nau’i na tushen ainihi masu jimilla da ninkar tabbatattu.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.c: Kullum yana aiki. Idan jimilla da ninkar tabbatattu ne, tushen biyu tabbatattu ne.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.c: Ba ka gwada misalan ƙaryatawa domin ganin ko alamomin jimilla da ninkar kaɗai sun isa ba.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.d: Mai yiwuwa bai yi aiki ba. Akwai yanayin da tushen ba lambobi na ainihi ba ne.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.d: Ka duba sharadin cewa tushen dole su zama lambobi na ainihi kafin alamomin jimilla da ninkar su bayyana alamomin tushen.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.explain: Idan ninkar tabbatacciya ce kuma tushen biyu lambobi ne na ainihi, suna da alama ɗaya; idan jimilla ma tabbatacciya ce, dukansu tabbatattu ne. Amma tushen ba lambobi na ainihi ba ne, wato tushen hasashe ne, ba a iya amfani da kalmar alama, kuma jimilla da ninkar na iya zama tabbatattu. Misali, tushen x² − 2x + 5 = 0 su ne 1 ± 2i.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri nau’i-nau’i biyu dabam (s, q) da ke ƙaryata da’awar Minar. Jimilla s da ninkar q duka tabbatattu ne, amma tushen x² − sx + q = 0 ba lambobi tabbatattu na ainihi ba ne.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi ƙimar s, sai ka ƙara q a hankali ka lura da yadda tushen ma’aunin yake canzawa.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowane s, gano kusan iyakar q da ke raba tushen ainihi da marasa ainihi.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.ok.c1: Jimilla da ninkar duka tabbatattu ne.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.fail.c1: s da q duka dole su fi 0.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Tushen biyu ba lambobi na ainihi ba ne, don haka da’awar ta gaza.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Ga wannan (s, q), tushen biyu lambobi ne na ainihi. Warware ma’aunin, ka duba ko tushen na ainihi ne.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.explain: Idan (s, q) = (2, 5), tushen su ne 1 ± 2i; idan (1, 1), tushen su ne (1 ± √3 i)/2; idan (4, 10), tushen su ne 2 ± √6 i. (5, 6) yana da tushen tabbatattu 2 da 3, (4, 4) kuma yana da tushe guda 2 mai maimaituwa, wanda tabbataccen lamba ce ta ainihi; saboda haka waɗannan ba sa ƙaryata da’awar. Misalan ƙaryatawa su ne inda tushen hasashe ne duk da jimilla da ninkar tabbatattu.
y-m-36-09.s.s3.prompt: Wane sharadi za ka ƙara domin da’awar Minar ta zama daidai? Ka rubuta dalili ma, kana ambaton misalin ƙaryatawa da ka ƙirƙira.
y-m-36-09.s.s3.hint.0: Ga (s, q) da ka yi amfani da su wajen ƙaryatawa, nemo tushen ma’aunin da kanka ka duba ko na ainihi ne.
y-m-36-09.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta sharadin da zai cire wannan misalin ƙaryatawa amma ya bar sharuɗɗan jimilla da ninkar yadda suke.
y-m-36-09.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Ana kuma buƙatar sharadin cewa tushen biyu ... Saboda ...
y-m-36-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin na duba cewa sharadin da na ƙara ya hana misalin ƙaryatawa (shin tushensa na ainihi ne)?
y-m-36-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin na bayyana dalilin da ya sa har yanzu ake buƙatar alamomin jimilla da ninkar (alamarsu ɗaya ce kuma jimilla tabbatacciya ce)?
y-m-36-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin na gwada da ƙima guda cewa da’awar Minar gaskiya ce bayan ƙara sharadin?
y-m-36-09.s.s3.model.0: Dole a ƙara sharadin cewa tushen biyu lambobi ne na ainihi, wato sharadin discriminant s² − 4q ≥ 0. Tunda ninkar tabbatacciya ce, tushen biyu suna da alama ɗaya; tunda jimilla tabbatacciya ce, duka tabbatattu ne. Misalin s = 2, q = 5 yana da discriminant korau, saboda haka tushen hasashe ne kuma sharadin ya ware shi.
y-m-36-09.s.s3.model.1: Tushen biyu dole su zama lambobi na ainihi (D ≥ 0). Idan aka haɗa wannan sharadi da s > 0, q > 0, da’awar cewa tushen biyu tabbatattun lambobi ne na ainihi ta zama gaskiya. Misalin (1, 1) da na ƙirƙira yana da tushen hasashe, don haka bai cika sharadin ba.
y-m-36-09.s.s3.modelNote.1: An bayyana sharadin zama na ainihi ba tare da amfani da kalmar discriminant ba.

y-m-36-08.title: Wanne daga cikin hanyoyin biyun zai ci gaba da kasancewa da amfani?
y-m-36-08.topic: Tushen lambatu na ma'auni mai siffar sukari da kwatanta hanyoyin mafita
y-m-36-08.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyin magance guda biyu, kimanta ƙarƙashin wane yanayi za'a iya amfani da kowannensu, kuma ku yi shirin warwarewa ta hanyar gina ma'aunin kubik tare da tushen lamba da kanku.
y-m-36-08.material: Hajun da Seoyun sun warware ma'auni mai siffar cubic x³ - 2x² - x + 2 = 0. Hajun: sun tattara kalmomi biyu na farko da na ƙarshe biyu suka canza shi zuwa x² (x - 2) - (x - 2) = (x - 2) (x² - 1). Seoyun: sa x = 1, ya tabbatar yana bada 0, kuma an raba ta x - 1 don samun (x - 1) (x² - x - 2). Dukansu sun sami tushen -1, 1, 2. (Karanta kamar: x cubed debe 2x squared debe x da 2 daidai 0)
y-m-36-08.thinking.0: Kwatanta da kimanta hanyoyin mafita da juna
y-m-36-08.thinking.1: Yi hukunci ko za a iya ci gaba da amfani da hanyar idan yanayi ya canza
y-m-36-08.thinking.2: Gina ma'auni wanda ya gamsar da sharuɗɗan
y-m-36-08.prereq.0: Ka'idar factor da rabon roba (raba polynomial ta hanyar magana mai layi)
y-m-36-08.prereq.1: Gaskiyar cewa 'yan takara na tushen integer na wani equation tare da ƙididdiga ƙididdiga sune masu rarraba na dindindin lokaci (matakin 10 equations unit) - H2 na wannan aikin shine kawai wahala da matakin tallafi a cikin wannan rabon samarwa; ba yana nufin tsarin koyarwa ya sanya abin da ya dace da wannan matakin ba. A ɗauka cewa an riga an koyi ilimin da ake buƙata a ƙasa.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ne mafi dacewa da kimantawa wanda ya kwatanta mafita guda biyu?
y-m-36-08.s.s1.hint.0: Don kowane mafita guda biyu, rubuta layi ɗaya akan wane nau'in matsalar (nau'in furci, madaidaicin kalmar) da ta yi amfani da ita.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin ko kowace mafita za ta iya ci gaba da amfani da ita idan ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan biyu ya ɓace.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.a: Maganin Hajun ne kawai. Seoyun kawai ya faru yana da x = 1 a matsayin tushen.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci yana ɗaukar gano tushen ta hanyar musanya kamar ba amintacce ba.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.b: Maganin Seoyun kawai yayi daidai. Ƙungiya dabara ce da ke aiki kawai don wannan matsala.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.b: Kun kalli kewayon inda hanya ɗaya ta shafi kuma ku yanke hukuncin ɗayan.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.c: Dukansu suna da inganci, kuma alamun kowannen da aka yi amfani da su ya bambanta.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.c: Kun bambanta cewa hanyoyin biyu suna amfani da alamu daban-daban.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.d: Amsoshi iri daya ne, don haka babu fa'ida wajen tantance hanyoyin daban.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.d: Ba ka bambanta gaskiyar cewa amsoshin iri ɗaya ne da yadda hanya take aiki a yanayi dabam-dabam ba.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.explain: Hajun ya yi amfani da yadda za a iya tsara furuci ta haɗa sharuɗɗa, Seoyun kuma ta yi amfani da masu raba lambar marar x a matsayin zaɓuɓɓukan tushen. Lissafin biyun daidai ne, amma sun dogara da sharuɗɗa dabam. Wannan matsala ta cika sharuɗɗan biyun, saboda haka duka hanyoyin sun yi aiki.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.prompt: Canza lambar marar x ta yadda ma’aunin ya zama x³ − 2x² − x + 3 = 0. Wace magana ce daidai game da wannan furuci?
y-m-36-08.s.s2.hint.0: Saka x = 1, −1, 3, −3, ka lissafta ƙimar furucin ga kowace.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta yadda alamar ƙimar furuci a x = −2 da x = −1 ta bambanta.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.a: Haɗa sharuɗɗan Hajun yana aiki yadda yake, kuma ana gama rabar furucin nan take.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.r.a: Ba ka rubuta ko bayan haɗa sharuɗɗa akwai wani abin gama-gari da ya rage ba. Duba cewa sharuɗɗan ƙarshe su ne −x + 3.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.b: Saka ±1, ±3 yana ba da ƙimomi waɗanda babu ɗayansu 0, saboda haka babu tushen lamba cikakkiya.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.r.b: Ka tantance iyakar abin da hanyar gwada duk zaɓuɓɓukan lambobi cikakku za ta iya gaya maka.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.c: Babu tushen lamba cikakkiya, saboda haka ma’aunin ba shi da mafita kuma an gama warwarewa.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.r.c: Ka ɗauki babu tushen lamba cikakkiya da babu mafita a matsayin abu ɗaya. Kwatanta alamun ƙimar furucin a x = −2 da x = −1.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.d: Haɗa sharuɗɗa da saka ƙima duka ba su yi aiki ba, saboda haka ba za a iya warware ma’aunin ba.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.r.d: Wannan hukunci yana cewa idan hanyoyin lambobi cikakku sun gagara, babu wata hanya. Ka yi tunanin yadda za ka iya tabbatar da akwai tushen lamba ta ainihi.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.explain: Saka x = 1, −1, 3, −3 yana ba da ƙimomin furuci 1, 1, 9, −39; babu ɗayansu 0, don haka babu tushen lamba cikakkiya. Amma a x = −2 ƙimar −11 ce, a x = −1 kuma 1 ce, saboda haka akwai tushen ainihi a tsakaninsu. Ba wai babu mafita ba ce; mafitar ba ta zama lamba cikakkiya ba.
y-m-36-08.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon, ga x³ − 2x² − x + c = 0, ƙirƙiri (r, c) inda r lamba cikakkiya ce kuma tushe ne. Shigar da misalai 3 masu c dabam. (r da c duka lambobi cikakku ne)

y-m-36-01.title: Ƙirga tushen gaske na ma’aunin da ke ɗauke da m
y-m-36-01.topic: Yawan tushen gaske na ma’auni mai ƙididdiga ta harafi, da bincika zato
y-m-36-01.goal: A cikin warwarewa inda duk lissafin yake kama da daidai, nemo layin da “ba za a iya amfani da shi ba sai an cika wani zato”, nemo duk yanayin da ke da tushe guda ɗaya na gaske, sannan bincika kewayon ta hanyar saka ƙimomi.
y-m-36-01.material: Jihu ya warware tambayar da ke ƙasa, wadda ke neman kewayon m da zai sa ma’aunin mx² − 4x + 1 = 0 a cikin x (m lamba ce ta gaske) ya sami tushen gaske biyu daban-daban. Tambayar ta ce “ma’auni” kawai, ba ta ce “ma’aunin murabba’i” ba. Tushen gaske mafita ce mai ƙima ta gaske, kuma idan tushen biyun ƙima ɗaya ce (tushe biyu), ana ƙirga shi tushen gaske guda ɗaya. (Karanta: m ninkin x murabba’i a cire 4x a ƙara 1 daidai yake da 0)
y-m-36-01.thinking.0: Bincika zato da kowane layi na warwarewar ya dogara da shi

y-m-36-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta abin da ka ƙirga da ƙarshen layi na 4. Idan wata ƙima ba ta dace ba, duba siffar da ma’aunin ya ɗauka a wannan ƙimar.
y-m-36-01.s.s1.line.0: Don samun tushen gaske biyu daban-daban, determinant dole ya cika D > 0.
y-m-36-01.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka kewayon da ake nema shi ne m < 4.
y-m-36-01.s.s1.explain: Lissafin layi na 2 da 3 (D = 16 − 4m, m < 4) daidai ne. Matsalar tana layi na 1. D > 0 sharadin tushen gaske biyu ne kawai idan ma’aunin murabba’i ne, amma a wannan tambaya idan m = 0, ma’aunin ya zama na layi −4x + 1 = 0, wanda ke da tushen gaske guda ɗaya, x = 1/4. Saboda haka ƙarshen layi na 4, m < 4, ya haɗa m = 0 bisa kuskure. Ko ka zaɓi layi na 1 ko layi na 4, ka ga gibin ɗaya daga wurare daban-daban. Idan kana shakkar layukan ukun farko kawai, sake duba lissafin kake yi ne kawai; muhimmin batu shi ne lissafin daidai ne.
y-m-36-01.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin m biyu daban-daban da za su sa ma’aunin mx² − 4x + 1 = 0 ya sami tushen gaske guda ɗaya, sannan shigar da su. (m lamba ce ta gaske)
y-m-36-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi ƙimar m, rubuta ma’aunin, sannan fara bincika siffar furucin a cikin x (digirinsa nawa ne).
y-m-36-01.s.s2.hint.1: Akwai dalilai biyu daban-daban da za su sa a sami tushe guda ɗaya na gaske. Ka yi tunani game da gibin da ka samo a matakin baya da kuma yanayin da tushen biyu suke a ƙima ɗaya.
y-m-36-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Ga wannan m, akwai tushe guda ɗaya na gaske tak.

y-m-36-01.s.s2.explain: Idan m = 0, to −4x + 1 = 0, saboda haka x = 1/4 kaɗai ne; idan m = 4, to 4x² − 4x + 1 = (2x − 1)² = 0, saboda haka x = 1/2 tushe ɗaya ne da aka ƙirga sau biyu. Waɗannan yanayi biyu ne masu dalilai daban-daban da ke ba da tushe guda ɗaya na gaske. m = 1 yana ba da tushen gaske biyu, m = 5 da m = −3 kuma suna ba da tushen gaske 0 da 2 bi da bi.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.prompt: A cikin waɗannan, wanne ne “kewayon m da ke da tushen gaske biyu daban-daban” daga mafitar da aka gyara? Ko wace m ka saka, za ka iya rubuta ma’aunin ka ƙirga tushen don tabbatarwa.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.hint.0: Saka m = −1, 1, 0, 4, 5 ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka tsara yawan tushen gaske a tebur.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.hint.1: A tebur, duba tazarar da ƙimomin m masu tushen gaske biyu suka taru a ciki, da inda hakan ya tsaya.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.o.a: Duk lambobin gaske m masu m < 4
y-m-36-01.s.s3.r.a: Wannan hukunci bai bincika siffar ma’aunin idan m = 0 ba tukuna.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.r.b: Ka bar ƙimar da digiri yake canjawa, sannan ka yi amfani da rashin daidaiton.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.r.c: Ka ƙirga da hannu ko akwai tushen gaske biyu idan m mara kyau ne ma (misali m = −1). Wataƙila ka yi tunanin m dole ya zama tabbatacce don ma’aunin ya zama murabba’i.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.r.d: Idan m = 4, tushen biyun sun zama ƙima ɗaya, saboda haka ba tushen gaske biyu daban-daban ba ne. Ba ka bambanta “yana da tushen gaske” da “daban-daban” ba.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.explain: Idan m = −1, to −x² − 4x + 1 = 0 yana da tushen gaske biyu; idan m = 1, x² − 4x + 1 = 0 ma yana da tushen gaske biyu. m = 0 yana ba da ma’aunin layi (tushe gaske 1), m = 4 kuma yana ba da tushe biyu (tushe gaske 1), saboda haka an cire su daga kewayon. y-m-36-04.title: Layukan da suka ratsa ta wurin (0, 4) da wurin (0, −4)
y-m-36-04.topic: Yawan wuraren haɗuwar parabola da layi (tsarin ma’aunai masu digiri biyu)
y-m-36-04.goal: Gwada hukuncin farko cewa canza gangare ba ya canza yawan wuraren haɗuwa, bisa wurin da layin ya ratsa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da tsarin sakamakon ya bambanta.
y-m-36-04.material: Parabola y = x² tana kan faifan daidaitawa. Kololuwarta asali ne, tana buɗewa sama. Wurin (0, 4) yana cikin parabola (sama da lanƙwasarta), wurin (0, −4) kuma yana wajenta (ƙasa da lanƙwasar). m lamba ce ta ainihi, ba a la’akari da layukan da suke a layi ɗaya da axis y. Layi y = mx + 4 yana ratsa (0, 4), layi y = mx − 4 kuma yana ratsa (0, −4). Yawan wuraren haɗuwa shi ne yawan mafita na ainihi (x, y) ga tsarin ma’aunai.

y-m-36-03.material: Ana cewa tushen guda na ma’aunin digiri biyu x² + px + q = 0 shi ne 1 + i. (i ƙididdigar hasashe ce mai i² = −1; ana karanta ta ai.) Duk lokacin da aka ƙara bayani, ka yanke hukunci kan abin da za a iya faɗa game da ɗayan tushen.

y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ba ka ƙara zato da ba a bayar ba, kuma ka dakatar da yanke hukunci.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: An tantance shi a matsayin −1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wataƙila ka yi tunanin a juya dukkan alamomi. Har sai ka lissafta jimilla da ninkar da kanka, babu hujjar hakan.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Tushen ninki biyu ne, iri ɗaya da 1 + i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya ɗauki sanin tushe guda ɗaya a matsayin daidai da sanin cewa tushen biyu iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Sabon bayani: p da q duka lambobi ne na ainihi. Idan ɗayan tushen s + ti ne, inda s da t lambobi ne na ainihi, jimillar tushen (1 + s) + (1 + t)i da ninkarsu (s − t) + (s + t)i duka dole su zama lambobi na ainihi. (Ninkar ita ce (1 + i)(s + ti) = s + ti + si + ti² bayan sauƙaƙawa.)
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Domin jimillar ta zama ta ainihi, 1 + t = 0, saboda haka t = −1. Domin ninkar ta zama ta ainihi, s + t = 0, saboda haka s = 1. Don haka ɗayan tushen 1 − i ne. Hukuncin farko cewa ba za a iya tantancewa ba daidai ne saboda bayanin bai isa ba; yanzu hukuncin ya canza saboda bayanin ya ƙaru.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka daidaita ɓangaren hasashe kawai domin jimillar ta zama ta ainihi, ba ka duba ninkar ba. Ka tantance ko ninkar lamba ce ta ainihi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Idan tushen biyu iri ɗaya ne, jimillar 2 + 2i ba lamba ce ta ainihi ba. Duba ko jimillar lamba ce ta ainihi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ba za a iya tantance shi ba.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Sabon bayani ya ba da ma’auni biyu, na jimilla da na ninkar, amma ka ci gaba da dakatar da hukunci kamar da.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan ita ce ƙimar da ake samu ta gano s da t da ke sa jimilla da ninkar su zama lambobi na ainihi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Muna canza wani bayani. A wannan karon mun cire maganar cewa p da q lambobi ne na ainihi, muka ce ɗayan tushen 2 ne. To x² + px + q = (x − (1 + i))(x − 2) = x² − (3 + i)x + (2 + 2i), saboda haka p = −3 − i kuma q = 2 + 2i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.after: A wannan misalin p = −3 − i da q = 2 + 2i ba lambobi na ainihi ba ne, don haka yana wajen zato cewa ƙididdigogi lambobi ne na ainihi. Ba tare da wannan zato ba, tushen guda 1 + i kaɗai ba ya tabbatar da cewa ɗayan 1 − i ne.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Idan ba a ɗauka p da q lambobi ne na ainihi ba, ba za a ce ɗayan tushen 1 − i ne ba.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka gano irin zato da kaddarar tushen kishiya ta dogara da shi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Idan tushen guda 1 + i ne, ɗayan tushen kullum 1 − i ne.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Sake duba ɗayan tushen a misalin da muka ƙirƙira yanzu.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Tushen ma’aunin digiri biyu kullum lamba ɗaya ce ta ainihi ɗaya kuma ta hasashe.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tushen 1 + i da 2 a wannan misalin na iya yi kama da haka, amma irin tushen ya danganta da ƙididdigogi. Yi tunanin yanayin da tushen biyu duka lambobi na ainihi ne, alhali ƙididdigogin ma ainihi ne.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ko da p da q lambobi ne na ainihi, ɗayan tushen ba lallai ya zama 1 − i ba.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: p da q a wannan misalin ba lambobi na ainihi ba ne. Duba sharuɗɗan da aka yi amfani da su wajen ƙirƙirar misalin.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.info: Ƙarin bayani na ƙarshe: p da q kuma lambobi ne na ainihi, amma yanzu tushen guda 1 + √2 ne, wanda ba lambar hasashe ba ce. Misali, idan ɗayan tushen 3 ne, to (x − (1 + √2))(x − 3) = x² − (4 + √2)x + 3 + 3√2, kuma p = −4 − √2 da q = 3 + 3√2 duka lambobi ne na ainihi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.ask: Za ka iya cewa ɗayan tushen 1 − √2 ne?
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.after: Sharadin cewa p da q lambobi ne na ainihi kaɗai bai tantance ɗayan tushen a matsayin 1 − √2 ba. 1 − √2 yana tabbata ne idan an ƙara sharadi mai ƙarfi cewa p da q lambobi ne masu ma’ana.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Idan p da q lambobi ne na ainihi, kullum ɗayan tushen 1 − √2 ne.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Duba ɗayan tushen a misalin da muka bayar yanzu.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Dole ne ya zama tushen ninki biyu, iri ɗaya da 1 + √2.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya ɗauki sanin tushe guda ɗaya da sanin tushen ninki biyu a matsayin abu ɗaya.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Ka ci gaba da dokar da aka yi amfani da ita ga tushen hasashe, ka canza alama kawai. Duba jimilla da ninkar.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Ba za a iya tantancewa ba. Ko ɗayan tushen ya zama 3, p da q lambobi ne na ainihi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Ka tabbatar da misali cewa sharadin ƙididdigogi na ainihi kaɗai bai isa ba.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.reflect: Da farko babu wani bayani, saboda haka hukuncin ba za a iya tantancewa ba daidai ne. Da aka samu bayanin p da q lambobi ne na ainihi, hukuncin ya canza zuwa 1 − i. A matakai biyu na gaba, ka duba da misalai sharuɗɗan da wannan ƙa’ida take rushewa. Ka waiwayi bayanin da aka samu da hukuncin da ya canza, ko wanda ya dace a bar shi yadda yake.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk yanayin da ɗayan tushen dole ne ya zama kishiyar lambar da aka bayar (siffar da alama kawai ta bambanta).
y-m-36-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowace zaɓi, zaɓi wani tushen da kake so, ka duba ko p da q za su cika sharadin zaɓin.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓin da za a iya ƙirƙirar ko misalin ƙaryatawa guda ɗaya da ya cika sharadinsa ba lallai ba ne.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.a: Tushen guda na ma’aunin digiri biyu mai dukkan ƙididdigogi na ainihi shi ne 3 − 2i
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.a: Ka tabbatar an cika sharuɗɗan biyu: an bayar da tushen hasashe, kuma ƙididdigogin na ainihi ne.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.b: Tushen guda na ma’aunin digiri biyu mai ƙididdigogi masu haɗaɗɗu shi ne 3 − 2i
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.b: Ka tuna da misalin ƙaryatawa na baya, ka yi tunanin ko wannan ƙa’ida tabbatacciya ce idan ba a ce ƙididdigogi na ainihi ba ne.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.c: Tushen guda na ma’aunin digiri biyu mai dukkan ƙididdigogi masu ma’ana shi ne 2 + √3
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya bambanta sharadin ƙididdigogi da ake buƙata domin ƙa’idar ta yi aiki ga tushen ainihi ma.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.d: Tushen guda na ma’aunin digiri biyu mai dukkan ƙididdigogi na ainihi shi ne 2 + √3
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya ɗauki sharuɗɗan tushen hasashe da na tushen marar ma’ana a matsayin abu ɗaya. Ka yi tunanin misalin da ɗayan tushen 3 ne.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.explain: Tushen hasashe na ma’aunin digiri biyu mai ƙididdigogi na ainihi yana zuwa tare da kishiyarsa; tushen 2 + √3 na ma’aunin mai ƙididdigogi masu ma’ana kuma yana zuwa tare da 2 − √3. Idan ƙididdigogi masu haɗaɗɗu ne, ko lambobi na ainihi kawai, tushen marar ma’ana ba ya tabbatar cewa ɗayan tushen kishiyarsa ne.

y-m-36-05.title: Iyakar k da ke aiki ga dukkan lambobin ainihi x
y-m-36-05.topic: Sharadin da rashin daidaiton digiri biyu zai cika ga duk x na ainihi, da ƙimar iyaka
y-m-36-05.goal: Bambanta ko sakamakon gwada wasu ƙimomi hujja ne ko tabbatarwa, sannan ka tabbatar cewa haɗa ƙimar iyaka ya danganta da ko alamar rashin daidaito > ce ko ≥.
y-m-36-05.material: Yanke a matakai iyakar k da x² − 4x + k > 0 zai cika ga dukkan x na ainihi. (Karatu: x murabba’i a rage 4x a ƙara k ya fi 0.) Ana ƙara bayar da bayani ɗaya-ɗaya.
y-m-36-05.thinking.0: Yi hukunci ko za a iya faɗaɗa sakamakon gwada wasu ƙimomi
y-m-36-05.thinking.1: Saka ƙimar iyaka da kanka domin tantance ko tana cikin iyakar
y-m-36-05.thinking.2: Kwatanta yadda ƙarshe yake canzawa idan sharadi ya canza
y-m-36-05.prereq.0: Mafi ƙarancin ƙima da kololuwar aikin digiri biyu
y-m-36-05.prereq.1: Dangantakar rashin daidaiton digiri biyu da jadawalin aikin digiri biyu (matakin sashen ma’aunai da rashin daidaito na aji 10) — H2 yana nufin matakin wahala da tallafi kawai, ba warewar darasi ga wannan aji ba. A ɗauka an riga an koyi ilimin da ake buƙata.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.prompt: Duk lokacin da aka bayar da bayani, zaɓi abin da za a iya faɗa bisa abin da aka sani yanzu.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.hint.0: Saka ƙimar iyaka ta k kai tsaye cikin furuci, sake rubuta shi a siffar (x − 2)², ka duba ƙimarsa a x = 2.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.hint.1: Saka ƙimar k iri ɗaya a yanayin > da kuma ≥, ka kwatanta ko kowannensu ya cika.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Da k = 5, saka x = −1, 0, 2, 3, 6 ya ba da ƙimomin furucin 10, 5, 1, 2, 17 bi da bi; duk tabbatattu ne.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me za ka ce game da k = 5?
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Ƙimomi 5 hujja mai kyau ne, amma ba gwajin dukkan lambobin ainihi ba ne. Idan ka san siffar furucin, wato mafi ƙarancin ƙimarsa, za ka iya tabbatarwa. Furucin nan yana da mafi ƙarancin ƙima 1 a x = 2, saboda haka k = 5 yana aiki da gaske.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Da yake ƙimomi biyar duka tabbatattu ne, za mu iya tabbatar da cewa rashin daidaiton yana cika ga duk lambobin ainihi x.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan hukunci bai yi la’akari da tazarar da ke tsakanin maki 5 da aka gwada da dukkan lambobin ainihi ba.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Yana yiwuwa ya riƙe, amma dabi'u biyar kadai ba za su iya tabbatar da mu ba.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci yana bambanta tsakanin ƙimar da aka bincika da kuma gamamme.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ƙimar tana ƙarami a x = 2, don haka baya riƙewa.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya ce ba ya riƙe saboda ƙimar ƙarami ne, kodayake ƙimar 1 tana da kyau. Abin da rashin daidaito ke buƙata shine ƙimar ta fi 0.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Sanya ƙarin dabi'u ba zai gaya mana ba, don haka ba za mu iya yanke shawara ba.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ba ku raba iyakacin sanya ƙarin ƙima daga gaskiyar cewa siffar furcin yana ba ku damar dubawa.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Lura: sanya x = 2 yana ba da ƙimar magana 4 - 8 + k = k - 4. Kuma darajar a x = 2 ita ce mafi ƙarancin ƙimar wannan magana.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: To wane kewayon za ku iya tsammanin k?
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Alamar ƙaramar ƙimar k - 4 ta yanke shawarar yanayin. Idan k> 4, duk ƙimar suna da kyau, kuma idan k <4, ya zama mara kyau a x = 2. Don iyakar k = 4, dole ne ku gwada shi kai tsaye don sanin ko an haɗa shi.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan shine tsammanin cewa mafi ƙarancin ƙima k - 4 dole ne ya fi 0 girma.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan shine tsammanin cewa mafi ƙarancin ƙima k - 4 dole ne ya zama 0 ko mafi girma. Kafin gwada iyakar k = 4, wannan kyakkyawan fata ne.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wataƙila kun kuskure k = 5 da aka bincika a baya don iyakar. Saka cikin k = 4.5.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan shine tsammanin cewa furcin koyaushe yana da kyau idan k yana da kyau. Nemo darajar a x = 2 lokacin da k = 1.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Gwajin iyaka: idan k = 4, furcin shine x² - 4x + 4 = (x - 2)². Ƙimar a x = 2 shine 0, kuma yana da inganci a duk sauran x.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: A cikin ainihin rashin daidaituwa x² - 4x + k> 0, shine k = 4 a cikin kewayon?
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Darajar a x = 2 shine 0, don haka "mafi girma 0" baya riƙe. Don haka k = 4 an bar shi kuma kewayon shine k> 4. Idan kuna tsammanin b a mataki na baya, wannan gwajin ya canza tsammanin ku, kuma idan kuna tsammanin a, ya tabbatar da cewa tsammaninku daidai ne.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yana ciki. Wannan saboda yana da inganci a mafi yawan x.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kuna karanta "duk ainihin lambobi" a matsayin "kusan duk ainihin lambobi."
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ba za ku iya sanin ko yana ciki ba tare da ganin matsalar ba.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kuna iya yanke shawara ta hanyar saka ƙimar iyaka kai tsaye, amma ba ku yi ba.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ba a ciki. Ƙimar ita ce 0 a x = 2, don haka> 0 ta kasa.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kun yi hukunci cewa idan rashin daidaito ya gaza a lokaci guda, ba ya riƙe ga duk ainihin lambobi.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.info: Canjin yanayi: yanzu canza alamar rashin daidaituwa kuma kuyi tunani game da k wanda x² - 4x + k ≥ 0 ke riƙe don duk ainihin lambobi x.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.ask: Shin k = 4 a cikin wannan kewayon?
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.after: (x − 2)² ≥ 0 yana riƙe da duk ainihin lambobi x, don haka k = 4 yana ciki kuma kewayon shine k ≥ 4. Ko don magana ɗaya, ko an haɗa ƙimar iyaka ya dogara akan ko alamar> ko ≥.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Yana cikin. Ko da ƙimar a x = 2 shine 0, ≥ 0 yana riƙe.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Kun yi hukunci bisa ga sharadi ko an ba da izinin 0 a kan iyaka.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Ba a ciki, an bar shi a baya, don haka an bar shi saboda wannan dalili.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Ba ku yi la'akari da cewa alamar rashin daidaituwa ya bambanta da rashin daidaituwa na baya ba.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Ba za mu iya sanin ko yana ciki ba. Don rashin daidaituwar ra'ayi, dole ne koyaushe ku sake warware ta sabo lokacin da alamar ta canza.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Kuna iya yanke shawara ta hanyar maye gurbin k = 4 kai tsaye, amma ba ku yi ba.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.reflect: Da farko yana da ma'ana kada a tabbata daga 'yan dabi'u, sannan sanya a cikin ƙimar iyaka kai tsaye tabbatar da ko an haɗa shi, kuma lokacin da alamar rashin daidaituwa ta canza, hukuncin ƙimar iyaka ɗaya ya canza. Faɗa waɗanne bayanan da suka canza hukuncinku kuma waɗanda suka bar hukuncinku ya kasance kamar yadda yake.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.prompt: Bari mu yi amfani da wannan hukunci ga wata sabuwar matsala. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan shine kewayon k wanda rashin daidaituwa -x² + 6x + k <0 ke riƙe da duk ainihin lambobi x?
y-m-36-05.s.s2.hint.0: Saka x = 3 kuma bayyana darajar magana cikin sharuddan k. Yi tunani ko wannan ƙimar ita ce mafi girman ma'ana akan jadawali.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.hint.1: Saka a k = -9 da k = -10 kai tsaye kuma kwatanta ko rashin daidaito yana riƙe a x = 3.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.r.a: Bayan sake rubuta furcin, duba ko alamun da ƙididdiga akai-akai sun yi daidai ta amfani da mafi girman ƙimar -x² + 6x.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.r.b: Kun samo mafi girman ƙimar -x² + 6x + k kuma kuka yanke hukunci cewa dole ne ya zama ƙasa da 0.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.r.c: Ba ku bincika ko a kan iyaka k = -9 mafi girman ƙimar ta zama 0, ta yadda <0 ta kasa.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.r.d: Kuna karanta jagorar alamar rashin daidaituwa ta wata hanya. Nemo ƙima a x = 3 lokacin da k = 0.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.explain: -x² + 6x + k = -(x - 3)² + 9 + k, don haka mafi girman darajar shine 9 + k a x = 3. Wannan ƙimar dole ne ta kasance ƙasa da 0, don haka k <-9, kuma idan k = -9 darajar a x = 3 shine 0, don haka <0 ya kasa.

y-m-36-06.title: Neman k domin akwai mafita guda bakwai
y-m-36-06.topic: Maganganun cikakkiyar rashin daidaiton ƙima da adadin mafita na lamba
y-m-36-06.goal: Karanta maganin cikakkiyar rashin daidaituwar ƙima a matsayin tazara, yi aiki yadda adadin hanyoyin magance ke canzawa tare da siga, yin ƙima da yawa waɗanda suka gamsar da yanayin, kuma bayyana kewayon su.
y-m-36-06.material: Don tabbataccen lamba k, ƙidaya lambobi x waɗanda suka gamsar da rashin daidaituwa | x - 1| ≤ k. (Karanta kamar haka: cikakkiyar ƙimar x debe 1 ƙasa da ko daidai yake da k) Misali, idan k = 1.5, lambobin x sune 0, 1, 2, don haka akwai 3.
y-m-36-06.thinking.0: Nemo wuraren da ƙidayar ta canza yayin da ma'aunin ya canza
y-m-36-06.thinking.1: Yi dabi'u da yawa waɗanda suka gamsar da yanayin
y-m-36-06.thinking.2: Bayyana kewayon ta yin aiki ko an haɗa ƙimar iyaka
y-m-36-06.prereq.0: Rubutun maganin cikakkiyar rashin daidaituwar ƙimar |x - a| ≤ b a matsayin tazara
y-m-36-06.prereq.1: Ƙididdigar ƙididdiga a kan layin lamba (Ma'auni na 10 da matakin rashin daidaituwa) - H2 na wannan aikin shine kawai wahala da matakin tallafi a cikin wannan rabon samarwa; ba yana nufin tsarin koyarwa ya sanya abin da ya dace da wannan matakin ba. A ɗauka cewa an riga an koyi ilimin da ake buƙata a ƙasa.
y-m-36-06.s.s1.prompt: Idan ka fara k a 2 kuma ka ƙara shi kaɗan kaɗan, yaushe ne adadin lambobi x ya canza?
y-m-36-06.s.s1.hint.0: Don k = 2, 2.5, 2.9, 3, rubuta maganin a matsayin tazara kuma jera maƙallan da ke cikinsa ɗaya bayan ɗaya.

y-m-36-07.title: Menene kewayon ke ba da sashi na gama gari?
y-m-36-07.topic: Sharadi don tsarin rashin daidaituwa na layi don samun mafita (ƙimar iyaka)
y-m-36-07.goal: Lokacin yanke shawarar yanayin rashin daidaituwa guda biyu don samun sashin gama gari, tabbatar ta hanyar maye gurbin kai tsaye cewa sakamakon a ƙimar iyaka ya bambanta dangane da nau'in alamar rashin daidaituwa, kuma bayar da shawarar hanyar da za ta karyata hukuncin da ba daidai ba.
y-m-36-07.material: Minsu ya samo kewayon wani tsarin rashin daidaituwa na 3x - 1> 5, x - a ≤ 3 (x adadi ne na gaske, a shine ainihin dindindin) yana da mafita, kamar haka. "Yana da mafita" yana nufin akwai aƙalla x guda ɗaya wanda ke gamsar da duka rashin daidaito. (Karanta kamar haka: 3x debe 1 ya fi 5, x a rage ko ya kai 3)
y-m-36-07.thinking.0: Bincika ko sarrafa iyaka a cikin maganin daidai ne
y-m-36-07.thinking.1: Kwatanta sakamakon a ƙimar iyaka dangane da nau'in alamar rashin daidaituwa
y-m-36-07.thinking.2: Ba da shawarar wata hanya don tabbatar da hukunci ta hanyar musanya dabi'u
y-m-36-07.prereq.0: Rubuta maganin rashin daidaituwar layi a matsayin tazara akan layin lamba
y-m-36-07.prereq.1: Maganin tsarin rashin daidaituwa shine ɓangaren gama gari na mafita na kowane rashin daidaituwa - H2 na wannan aikin shine kawai wahala da matakin tallafi a cikin wannan rabon samarwa; ba yana nufin tsarin koyarwa ya sanya abin da ya dace da wannan matakin ba. A ɗauka cewa an riga an koyi ilimin da ake buƙata a ƙasa.
y-m-36-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin da ba daidai ba a cikin maganin Minsu. Lambobin layi suna farawa daga layi na 1.
y-m-36-07.s.s1.hint.0: Saka a = -1 a ciki kuma sake rubuta rashin daidaito biyu. Yi alama akan layin lamba ko akwai x wanda ya gamsar da sharuɗɗan biyu.
y-m-36-07.s.s1.hint.1: Alama ko kowane ƙarshen tazara biyu daga layi na 1 da 2 yana cikin tazarar sa.
y-m-36-07.s.s1.line.2: Don samun ɓangaren gama gari, + 3 ≥ 2 dole ne a riƙe.
y-m-36-07.s.s1.explain: Sabuntawar layi na 1 da 2 daidai ne (x> 2, x ≤ a + 3). Wurin da ba daidai ba shine layi na 3. A cikin x> 2, 2 ba a haɗa shi ba, don haka idan + 3 = 2, babu x da zai gamsar da x> 2 da x ≤ 2. Don haka dole ne a + 3> 2 ya riƙe, kuma ƙarshen layi na 4 ya zama a > -1. Idan ka ɗauki layi na 4, ka nuna sakamakon da ke ɗauke da kuskure a layi na 3.
y-m-36-07.s.s2.prompt: Lokacin da c shine ainihin dindindin, zaɓi duk tsarin rashin daidaituwa waɗanda ke da mafita idan c = 3.
y-m-36-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, saka c = 3, rubuta tazara biyu, kuma duba ko x = 3 yana cikin tazara biyu.
y-m-36-07.s.s2.hint.1: Zana tazarar biyu akan layin lamba kuma kwatanta ko akwai wurin da suka zo juna.
y-m-36-07.s.s2.r.a: Kun duba ko akwai ɓangaren gama gari lokacin da ƙarshen tazara biyu iri ɗaya ne kuma ba ya haɗa da ƙarshen ƙarshen.
y-m-36-07.s.s2.r.b: Kun duba shari'ar inda bangarorin biyu suka haɗa da ƙarshen ƙarshen, don haka an bar maki ɗaya.
y-m-36-07.s.s2.r.c: Kun duba ko akwai ma'ana gama gari da ya rage lokacin da gefe ɗaya kawai ya haɗa da ƙarshen ƙarshen.
y-m-36-07.s.s2.r.d: Kun duba ko akwai sashe na gama gari a cikin kishiyar lamarin inda gefe ɗaya kawai ya ƙunshi ƙarshen ƙarshen.
y-m-36-07.s.s2.r.e: Kun duba ko tazara biyu sun yi karo da juna a wuri ɗaya lokacin da iyakoki suke ƙima ɗaya.
y-m-36-07.s.s2.explain: Lokacin c = 3, zaɓi b shine x ≥ 3 da x ≤ 3, don haka x = 3 shine mafita. Zabin e kuma shine x ≤ 3 da x ≥ 3, don haka x = 3 shine mafita. A cikin wasu, aƙalla gefe ɗaya baya haɗa da ƙarshen ƙarshen 3, don haka babu wani ɓangaren gama gari.
y-m-36-07.s.s3.prompt: Me zaku fadawa Minsu? Ba da shawarar hanya ɗaya don bincika wa kanku ko ƙaddamarwar Minsu a ≥ -1 daidai ne, kuma rubuta madaidaicin kewayon.

y-m-36-07.s.s3.hint.1: Yi alama akan layin lamba ko akwai x inda rashin daidaiton biyu suka zo juna.

y-m-36-10.title: Girman lambunan lambu da za su yiwu kusa da bango
y-m-36-10.topic: Tsara sharuɗɗan girma ta amfani da rashin daidaiton digiri biyu
y-m-36-10.goal: Rubuta yanayi mai iyakar tsawo a matsayin rashin daidaito na digiri biyu, nemo iyakar girman da zai yiwu, sannan ka yi hukunci yadda iyakar ke canzawa idan an ƙara wani iyaka da kuma lokacin da girma guda ɗaya kawai zai yiwu.
y-m-36-10.material: Ana amfani da igiya mai tsawon 20 m daidai don kewaye gefe 3 na lambun murabba’i mai tsawo. Gefen da ya rage yana manne da bango. Bari tsawon gefen da ke jikin bango ya zama w m, tsawon gefen da ya yi masa tsaye kuma x m. Igiya tana ba da w + 2x = 20. Fadin lambun x·w ㎡ ne, kuma ana son fadi aƙalla 48 ㎡. Duk tsawon ya fi 0, ma’aunin kuma m ne.
y-m-36-10.thinking.0: Mayar da sharuɗɗan jumla zuwa ma’aunai da rashin daidaito
y-m-36-10.thinking.1: Yi hukunci yadda iyakar yiwuwar ke raguwa idan sabon iyaka ya bayyana
y-m-36-10.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri zane-zane da dama da suka cika duk sharuɗɗan
y-m-36-10.prereq.0: Rubuta mafitar rashin daidaiton digiri biyu a matsayin tazara
y-m-36-10.prereq.1: Bayyana sharuɗɗan jumla a matsayin ma’aunai (matakin sashen ma’aunai da rashin daidaito na aji 10) — H2 yana nufin matakin wahala da tallafi kawai, ba warewar darasi ga wannan aji ba. A ɗauka an riga an koyi ilimin da ake buƙata.
y-m-36-10.s.s1.prompt: A ɗauka bangon yana da tsawo sosai, babu iyaka ga tsawon w. Wace tazara ta x ce za ta sa fadin ya kai aƙalla 48 ㎡? (x lamba ce ta ainihi)
y-m-36-10.s.s1.hint.0: Bayyana w ta amfani da x, rubuta fadin a matsayin furucin x kaɗai, sannan saka x = 3, 4, 5, 7 ka lissafta fadi ka tsara a jadawali.
y-m-36-10.s.s1.hint.1: A jadawalin nemo tazarar x da fadin ya kai 48 ko fiye.
y-m-36-10.s.s1.r.a: Ka rubuta fadi da furucin x sannan ka karanta mafitar rashin daidaito a matsayin tazara.
y-m-36-10.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci yana cewa fadi yana ƙaruwa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa. Nemo w da fadi idan x = 9.
y-m-36-10.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci yana cewa idan x ya ragu, ya fi kyau. Nemo fadi idan x = 1.
y-m-36-10.s.s1.r.d: Matsalar ba ta ce x dole lamba cikakkiya ba ne, amma ka yi tunanin lambobi cikakku kawai. Nemo fadi idan x = 4.5.
y-m-36-10.s.s1.explain: Tun da w = 20 − 2x, fadin shi ne x(20 − 2x). x(20 − 2x) ≥ 48 yana zama x² − 10x + 24 ≤ 0, wato (x − 4)(x − 6) ≤ 0; saboda haka 4 ≤ x ≤ 6. A nan w = 20 − 2x yana tsakanin 8 da 12, saboda haka kullum tabbatacce ne.
y-m-36-10.s.s2.prompt: Bangon ainihi tsawonsa 10 m ne, don haka w ≤ 10 dole ya cika. Shigar da nau’i-nau’i biyu (x, w) masu x dabam waɗanda fadinsu aƙalla 48 ㎡ kuma suka yi amfani da igiya 20 m gaba ɗaya. (x na iya zama goma-ɗaya a matakan 0.5)
y-m-36-10.s.s2.hint.0: Mayar da w ≤ 10 zuwa rashin daidaito na x, ka haɗa shi da tazarar da ka samu a baya.
y-m-36-10.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi ƙimomin x biyu cikin tazarar haɗin, lissafta w da fadi don tabbatarwa.

y-m-36-10.s.s2.fail.c2: w + 2x ba 20 ba ne. Duba sharadin amfani da igiyar gaba ɗaya.
y-m-36-10.s.s2.fail.c3: Fadin bai kai 48 ㎡ ba. Ninka x da w.

y-m-36-10.s.s3.prompt: Idan bangon tsawonsa 8 m kawai ne (w ≤ 8), za a iya samun lambun mai fadin aƙalla 48 ㎡?
y-m-36-10.s.s3.hint.0: Mayar da w ≤ 8 zuwa rashin daidaito na x, ka haɗa da tazara ta baya 4 ≤ x ≤ 6.
y-m-36-10.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko ɓangaren da suka haɗu tazara ce ko maki guda.
y-m-36-10.s.s3.o.a: Ba zai yiwu ba. Bangon ya yi gajarta, saboda haka fadin ba ya kai 48.
y-m-36-10.s.s3.r.a: Wannan hukunci yana cewa da zarar an ƙara iyaka, ba za a iya cimma buri ba. Nemo w da fadi a iyakar x = 6.

y-m-36-10.s.s3.r.b: Ka la’akari da iyakar bango kawai, ka bar sharadin fadi x ≤ 6. Nemo fadi idan x = 7.
y-m-36-10.s.s3.o.c: Duk ƙimar x daga 4 zuwa 6 tana yiwuwa.
y-m-36-10.s.s3.r.c: Ba ka yi la’akari da iyakar bango ba. Duba w idan x = 4.
y-m-36-10.s.s3.r.d: Ka duba yanayin da tazarar sharuɗɗan biyu suka taɓa a maki guda kawai.
